correctness.rationale: The actual RESULT.md establishes an invariant finite-fourth-moment affine reset-epoch recurrence and stationary generator, then solves its degree-two and degree-four moments for arbitrary symmetric driver-restart seed with positive variance and finite fourth moment. Independent exact rational generator recurrences agree in 96 assertions. The normalized excess kurtosis has numerator [(β+1)χ-(2β+3)]w²+5βw+7β+3 and positive denominator. If χ is at least (2β+3)/(β+1), all coefficients are nonnegative and the constant is positive; otherwise strict concavity gives exactly one positive sign-change root. Symmetric three-point seeds realize every χ>=1. This concerns only reset of driving Brownian coordinate, not particle position; no Gaussianity of the entire position law is inferred from K=0.
residual_risks: Unrestricted assertions rest on the analytic proofs, not finite checks.

A natural sharp fourth-cumulant phase classification for a physical driver-reset model, distinguishing seed laws by normalized fourth moment and furnishing the unique variance crossing.
